name: EURC
oneLiner: EURC is Circle's centralized euro stablecoin, redeemable 1:1 by qualifying customers and backed by cash and short-term assets denominated in euros.
collateral: Euro-denominated fiat reserves held separately from Circle operating funds at regulated financial institutions in the EEA
pegMechanism: Direct 1:1 redemption through Circle Internet Financial Europe SAS (licensed EMI under MiCA); Circle Mint enables institutional mint/redeem at zero fees with near-instant settlement

mintAuthority.summary: EURC is issuer-minted by Circle; Ethereum EURC uses a MasterMinter contract for minter management and an EOA token owner/admin. All addressable controls confirmed at block 25294757.

controls.label: Ethereum EURC MasterMinter
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25294757, masterMinter() on the EURC token returned 0x02398771fd1db790ef2B656Ca3BCB3075F27A72c. Blockscout confirms this is a MasterMinter contract (same Circle pattern as USDC). getMinterManager() returned 0x1abaea1f7c830bd89acc67ec4af516284b1bc33c (EURC token), confirming it manages EURC minting. MasterMinter owner() returned 0xa1a083189c5425af0bc59a58b2f1649d5236871b; eth_getCode confirms that address is an EOA (no bytecode), consistent with Circle enterprise MPC/HSM custody.

controls.label: Ethereum EURC token owner
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25294757, owner() on the EURC token returned 0x3101386a38bEf8B79E49f12DEa12938A30e8AF96. eth_getCode confirms this is an EOA (no bytecode), consistent with Circle enterprise MPC/HSM custody. Proxy admin (storage slot 1, Centre custom proxy) = 0x2c576cfc9612541eb827b5c52479f364ddfafeb7; eth_getCode confirms EOA.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25294757: masterMinter() = 0x02398771... (MasterMinter contract, getMinterManager confirms it manages EURC token); MasterMinter owner = EOA 0xa1a083...; EURC owner() = EOA 0x3101386...; proxy admin slot 1 = EOA 0x2c576cfc....
